note: Twenty-one ways to open a YouTube video. The opening has three jobs in about fifteen seconds: keep the title's promise, raise a question the viewer can't answer yet, and show the answer is coming. An opening that only does the last is a summary, and summaries lose people. Each formula has its shape, an example, how it goes wrong, and the patterns hookscore.py uses to recognise it in speech.
rules: Say what the title promised in the first sentence. Viewers who don't hear it in the first few seconds go back to the feed.
One promise. An opening with two delivers neither.
Exact beats big: 'from 400 to 200,000 subscribers in seven months' beats 'huge growth'.
If you promised to show something, show it within twenty seconds.
Don't open with who you are. Nobody has a reason to care yet.

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.shape: A number the viewer didn't know, said plainly, then what it means for them.
hooks.example: Most new channels stop before their thirtieth video. Here is what the ones that keep going do differently.
hooks.fails_when: Dies if the number is vague or can't be checked. Say where it comes from.

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.shape: A named person's result, then how they got it.
hooks.example: One channel went from 400 subscribers to 200,000 in seven months with a single format. I took it apart.
hooks.fails_when: Never invent the figure. If you can't name the person, pick another formula.

hooks.name: The Mistake
hooks.shape: Name the error the viewer is probably making right now.
hooks.example: Your first thirty seconds are why people don't finish your videos. And it isn't your topic.
hooks.fails_when: Works only if the mistake is common and the viewer can recognise it instantly.

hooks.name: Contrarian Flip
hooks.shape: State the usual advice, then reject it.
hooks.example: Everyone says post every day. I posted once a week for a year and the channel tripled.
hooks.fails_when: Needs proof in the next fifteen seconds, or it sounds contrary for the sake of it.

hooks.name: The Reveal
hooks.shape: Promise to show a specific thing, then show it.
hooks.example: I'm going to show you, on screen, the exact prompt that wrote this video.
hooks.fails_when: Show it early. A reveal at minute eight is a drop-off at minute one.

hooks.name: The Superlative
hooks.shape: The best, worst, fastest or only one of something.
hooks.example: This is the fastest way to turn one long video into thirty Shorts.
hooks.fails_when: Cheap unless you name what it beat.

hooks.name: The Clock
hooks.shape: Put a time limit on the payoff.
hooks.example: In the next six minutes you'll have a title, a thumbnail and a script for your next video.
hooks.fails_when: The clock must be true. Run over once and the next promise isn't believed.

hooks.name: I Tried It
hooks.shape: A first-person experiment with a real cost.
hooks.example: I let an AI run my channel for thirty days and didn't touch a single upload.
hooks.fails_when: Needs a stake - time, money or risk - or nothing is on the line.

hooks.name: The Question
hooks.shape: Ask the exact question the viewer typed into search.
hooks.example: Why do your videos lose people at thirty seconds when the topic is good?
hooks.fails_when: It has to be the viewer's question, not yours. Your comments are full of them.

hooks.name: Before and After
hooks.shape: Two states and the cut between them.
hooks.example: This was my thumbnail. This is it now. Same video, four times the clicks.
hooks.fails_when: Needs something to show. Don't use it on a talking head alone.

hooks.name: The Teardown
hooks.shape: Take something real apart in public.
hooks.example: I pulled the nine most-watched videos in this niche this month and broke down what their titles share.
hooks.fails_when: Say what you pulled and how many. A teardown of one example is an anecdote.

hooks.name: The Stack
hooks.shape: Two named tools combined into one result.
hooks.example: Claude plus your Studio export gives you next week's upload plan in one prompt.
hooks.fails_when: Both tools must be nameable, and the result must need both.

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.shape: A cost the viewer is about to pay.
hooks.example: Don't upload another video until you've checked this one setting.
hooks.fails_when: If the cost is small the warning is a lie. Use it rarely.

hooks.name: The List
hooks.shape: A counted list, with the count in the first line.
hooks.example: Seven things I'd do differently if I started a channel this year.
hooks.fails_when: The count must be exact and each item genuinely different.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.shape: Show the evidence first, explain second.
hooks.example: This is the analytics page. This one video made forty percent of the channel's watch time. Here's why.
hooks.fails_when: Needs the real screenshot. A receipt you only describe isn't one.

hooks.name: The Insider
hooks.shape: Something from inside a system most people never look at.
hooks.example: YouTube tells you which of your videos are underperforming. Almost nobody opens that report.
hooks.fails_when: Never claim access you don't have.

hooks.name: The Impossible Claim
hooks.shape: Say something that sounds untrue, then prove it.
hooks.example: You can write, title and schedule a week of videos without opening an editor.
hooks.fails_when: The proof must start within twenty seconds, or it reads as clickbait.

hooks.name: The Comparison
hooks.shape: Two named options and a winner.
hooks.example: I wrote the same video three ways. One kept sixty-two percent of viewers. The other two didn't.
hooks.fails_when: Name the loser out loud. A comparison with no loser is an advert.

hooks.name: The Origin
hooks.shape: Where a result really came from.
hooks.example: Every video on this channel starts in the same twelve-line file. Here it is.
hooks.fails_when: Works once per channel. It's a reveal about you, and there's only one of you.

hooks.name: The Deadline
hooks.shape: Something changes on a date.
hooks.example: The old way of writing descriptions stops working this month. This is what replaces it.
hooks.fails_when: Only with a real date someone can check. Nothing loses trust faster.

hooks.name: The Direct Address
hooks.shape: Name exactly who this is for in the first six words.
hooks.example: If you have under a thousand subscribers, this is the only video you need this week.
hooks.fails_when: Narrow beats broad. 'If you make videos' speaks to nobody.
